title: About Users in the Agentic Security Operations Platform

blocks.text: You can view a consolidated list of user accounts and their identity types, and review the identity findings and total number of critical or high-severity findings to take the necessary action. Only users in an active state are displayed on the Users page.
Managing users provides the following benefits and enables you to:

blocks.item: Aggregate users from different sources for a centralized view.
View user details and identity findings for each user.
Monitor internal and external users.

blocks.text: On the Users page (Agentic SOC > Users, Identities > Users, or AEM > Users), you can do the following:

blocks.item: Select from system-saved views or views you previously saved.
Search for a user by entering keywords in the search bar.
Save the current view for quick access after making adjustments to it (e.g., applying filters, adjusting columns, or grouping).
Filter assets by Name, Type, Identity Type, or Sources.
View the distribution of identities based on the type (User, Service Principal, or Special Identities).
View the distribution of users based on the type (Internal or External).
Group users by category (e.g., user first seen, user last seen, user tags, etc.).
Refresh the page to reflect the most current information.
Export the list of users and their associated details as a CSV file.
Modify the columns displayed in the table.
View the list of users. Click a user to view detailed information. For each user, you can see:
ID: The unique identifier of the user.
Name: The name of the user.
Is Admin: The user's admin role status. If the user is an admin, this field shows true.
Total Identity Findings: The total number of critical, high, medium, and low identity findings for the user.
Sources: The source of the user (e.g., Active Directory, Microsoft Entra ID, etc.).
Identity Type: The type of identity (User, Service Principal, or Special Identities).
Last Activity Date: The date of most recent activity.
State: The state of the user's account (Active or Inactive).
Type: The type of user (Internal or External).
